text:
incident-bot: P0 ALERT: Possible cross-tenant routing detected for dedicated pool 'ded-pool-42' serving VPC customers. High error-rate and anomalous tenant_id mappings observed. Paging oncall.
alice_oncall: Acked. I’m on it — stepping through now. What’s the customer impact? :eyes:
bob_sre: From quick logs, requests from Borealis Health (tenant_id=borealis-701) are hitting backend instances labelled for tenant acme-ops (tenant_id=acme-12). Rate of misrouted requests ~0.7% of traffic, but some contain PII fields — this needs containment.
elaine_infra: Current state: ded-pool-42 is a mixed-tenant pool on 6 nodes. Router config shows two prefix routes that look suspiciously similar: /kv/prefix/bh-701 and /kv/prefix/bh701 (missing hyphen). Looks like prefix collision in router lookup.
bob_sre: Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z request_id=abc123 tenant_id=borealis-701 routed_to=pod-acme-12 path=/v1/generate user_email=j.smith@borealis.example
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z request_id=abc123 served_by=pod-acme-12 response_code=200
```
alice_oncall: Ok that's enough to treat as tenant isolation risk. Priority: isolate affected tenant traffic and collect forensic data. Proposed immediate mitigation: drain ded-pool-42 from router rotation for new requests, disable KV prefix normalization, and enable strict prefix matching. Can infra evict the pool quickly? :zap:
elaine_infra: We can set pool to readonly and remove from new allocations. Running drain now:
```
# drain command
infractl pool update ded-pool-42 --serve-new=false --drain=true
```
elaine_infra: Issued. Nodes reporting drain started. That should stop new sessions within ~30s. Existing sessions still active.
dan_security: Start live capture for forensic. Please capture tcpdump on node-03 and node-05. Also snapshot KV state for keys matching both prefixes.
elaine_infra: Capturing now:
```
sudo tcpdump -w /var/tmp/dedpool42.node03.pcap host 10.10.5.23 and port 443
redis-cli --rdb /tmp/kv-snap.rdb
```
bob_sre: I’ve run a quick grep across logs to find other occurrences: found 14 unique request_ids where tenant_id mismatch occurred in past 12 hours. Attaching list to incident tracker. Will feed to sec for deeper analysis.
faye_support: Notifying CS to prepare a mitigation message to Borealis Health and offer an incident call. Draft note suggestion: "We've detected a potential routing issue that may have exposed request routing — we are containing the issue and will share findings shortly." Want to run this by legal? :phone:
dan_security: Legal loop already pinged (high priority). Do NOT include specifics about PII in customer-facing note until we confirm scope.
alice_oncall: Next steps for now: (1) hold pool drained; (2) rotate routing table to strict-match; (3) snapshot and collect logs for sec; (4) escalate to product for prefix normalization bug.
elaine_infra: Implementing strict prefix matching on edge router now. Config patch:
```
edge-router> set route-match-mode ded-pool-42 strict
edge-router> reload-config
```
elaine_infra: Reload completed. Edge reports strict match enabled. We'll watch for any remaining misrouted hits.
bob_sre: After strict match, observed misroute count dropped to 0 within 2 minutes. Existing cross-tenant sessions still need review; sec please confirm whether any payloads contained sensitive fields.
dan_security: Initial review: 7 of 14 misrouted requests had JSON bodies containing patient identifiers. Marking as potential exposure. We'll run full content scan on captured logs and pcap. Will update in 1 hour with scope.
faye_support: I've drafted a cautious customer message and queued it with legal. Ready to send once sec gives guidance.
alice_oncall: Good. For tracking: creating a formal incident ticket and marking customer impact = potential PII exposure, status = mitigating. Assigning postmortem to eng-runtime and infra teams.
user-researcher: quick note — saw similar hyphen normalization bug in a test harness last quarter; might be regression from earlier router normalization change.
bob_sre: Filing bug: ROUTER-1029 "prefix normalization edge-case with hyphens" and linking to this incident.
elaine_infra: Removing ded-pool-42 from rotation completed. No new misroutes after removal. We'll keep nodes cordoned for a full forensic snapshot.
dan_security: Forensic capture started. Collecting redis RDB, request logs, and pcap. Also contacting SOC for possible notification requirements.
alice_oncall: Handing off to night oncall (elaine_infra will continue monitoring). My notes: containment successful (strict-match + drain), data capture in progress, legal looped, CS draft ready but on hold. Leaving incident open for sec analysis and customer comms.
elaine_infra: Ack, continuing monitoring. Will post updates in thread when sec completes scope.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: containment achieved. ded-pool-42 drained and removed from rotation. Forensic capture in progress. Incident state: mitigated -> investigation. Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-17
dan_security: Update 45m: sec confirms 9 unique request_ids contained PII. We're preparing a scope summary. Recommend notifying affected customers and offering forensic report. Legal approves controlled notification.
faye_support: Sending notification to Borealis channel now (template: acknowledgement, mitigation, timeline, offer for call). I will paste copy here once sent.
faye_support: Sent to Borealis primary contact (private). They requested a bridge at 16:00 UTC. Scheduling now.
alice_oncall: Thanks team. I'll draft postmortem template and coordinate owners. Closing my shift. :pray:
